note: Per-call provider usage of these Claude subagents, read from their transcripts and deduplicated by API message id. Anthropic usage fields are disjoint (input_tokens excludes cache reads and cache writes), so they are listed side by side, never added. advisor_calls counts server-side advisor calls, whose own model usage is not in these fields. harness_counters are the completion notification's own counters. The coordinator session is not included.
